name: tsgo-lsp
description: TypeScript/JavaScript code intelligence via the TypeScript 7 native language server (tsgo): type errors after edits, go-to-definition, references. Uses ~50% less memory than tsserver and stops itself when idle.

idle_minutes.title: Idle stop (minutes)
idle_minutes.description: Stop the TypeScript server after this many minutes without LSP activity; it restarts automatically on the next request. 0 = never stop.
